instruction.text: Is the sentence in active or passive voice?

hint.text:
With sentences in active voice, the subject performs the action.

With sentences in passive voice, the subject receives the action.

atoms.a: He threw the ball in my direction.
The bathroom was being cleaned when we arrived.
We had already sold most of our things in the garage sale.
This bread was baked by a renowned baker.
Her flight was delayed by more than two hours.
He had drawn the line for the last time.
We had been promised fresh eggs from their farm.
The hamsters had already been fed.
My report will be corrected by tomorrow.
She likes to read in her lunch break.
Many animals are given away to the pound.

instruction.text: Rewrite the sentence using the passive voice.

hint.text: Remember to keep the sentence in the correct verb tense.

atoms.a: The girls will pick blueberries this afternoon.
atoms.b: Blueberries ((will_be_picked)) by the girls this afternoon.

atoms.a: Dan and Noa placed the old furniture in the car.
atoms.b: The old furniture ((++was_placed)) in the car by Dan and Noa.

instruction.text: Rewrite the sentence using the active voice.

hint.text: Remember to keep the sentence in the correct verb tense.

atoms.a: That plane is being flown by her.
We were taught how to warm-up before training by our coach.
atoms.b: Our coach ((taught)) us how to warm-up before training.

atoms.a: The last slice of cake has been eaten by someone.
atoms.b: Someone ((has_eaten ate)) the last slice of cake.

atoms.a: We were eyed inquisitively by the fox.
